_comment: AlfieBot settings. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Delete a key to use its built-in default.

display._comment: The 5-inch Pi display is 1280x720 in landscape. Lower supersample or glow if the Pi runs slowly.

conversation._comment: Seconds. listen_timeout: how long AlfieBot waits for an answer before going idle. sleep_after_idle: idle time before falling asleep. thinking_time: pause before replying. wake_delay: time for the eyes to open when woken from sleep.

speech._comment: tts_engine: auto (Piper if a Piper voice is installed, otherwise the Windows voice on Windows or espeak-ng on the Pi), piper, windows, espeak or none. piper_voice: the Piper voice in models/piper (get one with tools/download_voice.py). voice: part of a Windows voice name (e.g. Hazel or George) or an espeak voice (e.g. en-gb). rate: -10 (slow) to 10 (fast), Windows and espeak only. volume: 0-100. speed: overall speed for every voice and profile (1.0 normal, 0.8 slower, 1.2 faster). personality: bubbly (Bubbly Bot: cheerful, a little higher, sound effects) or classic (the v0.6 voice). voice_profile: auto (the personality picks a profile for each reply) or a profile name to always use it. pitch: semitones up (+) or down (-) for every profile (Piper and espeak-ng; Windows voices only if they support it). speaker_device: blank for the default speaker (Piper only). recognizer: vosk or none. mic_mode: open (listens whenever AlfieBot is listening) or push_to_talk (only while the button is held). mic_device: blank for the default microphone, or part of its name. min_confidence: spoken letters below this are checked with the child. allow_cloud_voices: parent setting, false by default. True lets the Voice panel compare with a Microsoft online voice (pip install edge-tts); only AlfieBot's own words are sent, never anything Alfie says. cloud_voice: e.g. en-GB-MaisieNeural (a child's voice) or en-GB-SoniaNeural.

voice_profiles._comment: Change how each profile sounds. rate: speed (1.0 normal, 0.8 slower). volume: 0-1. pitch: semitones (+2 = a little higher). sentence_pause, word_pause, letter_pause: seconds. expressiveness: Piper only, 1.0 normal. Leave a profile out to use the built-in settings, e.g. "teacher": {"letter_pause": 0.9}. Bubbly Bot's profiles are bubbly_conversation, bubbly_excited, clear_spelling_teacher and bubbly_sleepy.

spelling._comment: How spoken spellings are checked. confirm_spoken_answers: always (AlfieBot reads the letters back for a yes before marking) or when_unsure (only when a letter was unclear). phonetic_words: child (B for ball), nato (B for bravo) or off, used when AlfieBot asks about an unclear letter. finish_after_pause: seconds of quiet after some letters before AlfieBot checks them (0 = wait for 'finished').

ai._comment: The AI brain. Only a pretend (mock) AI exists so far: a real local model (Ollama) comes next. enabled: false uses only the hand-written replies. mode: local_only, cloud_only or automatic. cloud_enabled: parent setting, false by default; even when true a child's words never go to the cloud until privacy checks are built (only an adult test session can use it). timeout_s: how long AlfieBot waits for an AI answer before giving a hand-written reply. mock_delay_s: makes the pretend AI take this long, to see the thinking face.

privacy._comment: Parent settings. The microphone stays off until a parent turns it on. Audio is never saved unless keep_audio_recordings is true.

sounds._comment: Short electronic sound effects (made by the code, no files). bubbly / classic: use them with that personality. wake, listen, celebrate: each effect on or off. volume: 0-1.
